reviews.author: Kinga
reviews.text:
A real Brazilian restaurant. A small, inconspicuous place from the street with delicious food. If you have never had contact with Brazilian cuisine, this is the perfect place.

Delicious appetizers, main courses and desserts. I recommend trying the appetizer in the form of a donut filled with meat and covered with potato mass. Very well-done steaks with onions, fries and perfectly cooked rice.

Desserts are also Brazilian, very light and filling. There's definitely nothing to complain about. Very nice service.

reviews.author: Manoel Cação
reviews.text:
I have been there. As a Brazilian looking for a Brazilian restaurant, to have a meal like at home. Sounds like a food prepared from mom.

Special flavour and a small piece of Brazil in Zurich.

Really recommend the restaurant.

Good food, great people to serve. Well treated.

reviews.author: Kaesar Romanova
reviews.text: Authentic Brazilian cuisine! Brazilian Chef! Amazing service! The restaurant’s atmosphere made me feel like I was in Brazil! It’s become my favorite place in Zurich!
